5147-7084-8293.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Cleveland Booker triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

4681-5170-6094-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

323-4279-5687--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
323-4279-5687--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Falkenrath Noble, Skittering Precursor and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor ability, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2079-5078-6918-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

985-5078-7060-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4549-6026--52.description:
Activate Relic of Legends's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Field of Souls triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

728-2281-6132.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Saffi triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

2653-2893-6763-7886.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the basic land enters, Nissa and Beorn's Hospitality trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Beorn's Hospitality trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

670-1619-6145-6473.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-6145-6473.description:
Cast Mardu Siegebreaker by paying its mana cost.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Mardu Siegebreaker trigger, exiling Passageway Seer until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Mardu Siegebreaker.
Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield, causing Passageway Seer to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Passageway Seer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Passageway Seer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Mardu Siegebreaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Mardu Siegebreaker trigger, exiling Passageway Seer until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Mardu Siegebreaker.
Repeat from step 5.

1939-2919-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1939-2919-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Lunarch Veteran triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1352-1869-4050.description:
Cast Mistbind Clique by paying {3}{U}.
Mistbind Clique enters the battlefield, triggering its champion ability and Inalla.
Resolve the Inalla trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Mistbind Clique with haste.
The token Mistbind Clique enters the battlefield, championing the nontoken Mistbind Clique.
The nontoken Mistbind Clique leaves the battlefield, returning nothing from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the nontoken Mistbind Clique trigger from step 2, choosing not to exile anything.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Mistbind Clique token, adding at least one mana.
The Mistbind Clique token leaves the battlefield, returning the nontoken Mistbind Clique from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1453-2292-4559-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
1453-2292-4559-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Arwen.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

471-1331.easyPrerequisites:
Scythe of the Wretched attached to Pestilence Demon.
Your life total is at least 2.
471-1331.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Pestilence Demon deathtouch.
471-1331.description:
Give Pestilence Demon deathtouch by any method.
Activate Pestilence Demon by paying {B}, dealing 1 damage to each creature and player.
Each creature dealt damage by Pestilence Demon dies due to Pestilence Demon's deathtouch.
Scythe of the Wretched triggers for each creature that dies this way, returning them to the battlefield under your control, ensuring that Pestilence Demon is returned last so that Scythe of the Wretched will be attached to it.
You may repeat this combo as desired.

1170-1329-1482-2905.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Jeweled Lotus.
Cast Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Pestermite.
When Pestermite enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

261-2034-3000-4593.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Suture Priest triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
261-2034-3000-4593.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

4017-4268-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4017-4268-5641.description:
Gain life.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

228-2351-4050-4962.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
You control another creature with toughness equal to 1.
228-2351-4050-4962.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Skullclamp's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to another creature with toughness equal to 1.
The creature dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. The Watcher's second ability triggers if the creature was a Tentacle, and Skullclamp triggers.
Resolve the Watcher trigger, if applicable, untapping a Kraken and putting a stun counter on a permanent.
Resolve the Skullclamp trigger, causing you to draw two card.
The Watcher's first ability triggers twice, creating two 1/1 Tentacle creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Tentacle, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2034-2308-2324.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2308-2324.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Proper Burial triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1069-1232-5499-6633.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1232-5499-6633.description:
Activate Nemata's first ability by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Saproling.
Activate the Saproling by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

1808-2438-3000.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature you control.
Eloise's first ability triggers, and Eloise's second ability triggers if the creature was a token.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, if applicable, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1491-2757-6218-6260.easyPrerequisites: Sinking Feeling attached to Pheres-Band Tromper.
1491-2757-6218-6260.notablePrerequisites: Pheres-Band Tromper does not have summoning sickness.
1491-2757-6218-6260.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

560-2835-4550-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-2835-4550-5231.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier, adding {R}{R}.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Fecundity triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat.

877-1374-5910-6205.description:
Cast Nameless Inversion from your graveyard, as it is a Knight card, by paying {0} due to Case of the Ransacked Lab and Morophon, giving a creature +3/-3 until end of turn.
If the creature has toughness 0 or less, the creature dies as a state-based action.
Repeat as desired.

413-3652-5220-5683.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ornithopter.
When Ornithopter dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Ornithopter from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Ornithopter and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
When Ornithopter enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

4186-5783-5784.description:
Cast Plumecreed Mentor by paying {1}{W}{U}.
When Plumecreed Mentor enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token that has flying and vigilance due to Aven Wind Guide.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Plumecreed Mentor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Repeat from step 3.

2062-4776.description:
Cast Sprouting Phytohydra by paying {4}{G}.
When Sprouting Phytohydra enters the battlefield, Marauding Raptor triggers, dealing 2 damage to Sprouting Phytohydra.
Sprouting Phytohydra dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Sprouting Phytohydra triggers, creating a token copy of itself.
Repeat from step 2.

914-1170-2493-3556.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1170-2493-3556.description:
Cast Flicker by paying {1}{W}, targeting Archaeomancer.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Dockside Extortionist.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Resolve Flicker, blinking Archaeomancer.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

411-3198-4872.description:
Cast Lore Drakkis for its mutate cost by paying {U/R}{U/R}, putting it under Grinning Ignus.
Lore Drakkis triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Grinning Ignus by paying {R} and returning it and Lore Drakkis from the battlefield to your hand, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Cast Grinning Ignus by paying {2}{R}.
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1987-2556-3836-5002.notablePrerequisites:
Urza, Lord Protector and The Mightstone and Weakstone melded into Urza, Planeswalker.
You control a basic Island.
1987-2556-3836-5002.description:
Activate Urza, Planeswalker's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing instant spells you cast this turn to cost {2} less and causing you to gain two life.
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking Mnemonic Wall and a basic Island.
Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1887-2814.notablePrerequisites: Chandra in hand.You have at least one red instant and/or sorcery in your graveyard.
1170-1887-2814.description:
Cast Chandra by paying {4}{R}{R}, causing it to enter with ten loyalty counters due to Vorinclex.
Activate Chandra's third loyalty ability by removing seven loyalty counters from it, casting a red instant and/or sorcery from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Chandra, causing it to enter with ten loyalty counters due to Vorinclex.
Resolve the instant or sorcery spell.
Repeat from step 2.

3858-4658.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 9.
3858-4658.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Soul of Eternity.
Mayael's Aria then triggers, gaining you ten life, causing Soul of Eternity's power to be at least twenty.
Mayael's Aria triggers, winning you the game.

2480-3609-3842.notablePrerequisites: Magistrate's Scepter has a charge counter on it.
2480-3609-3842.description:
Cast Planewide Celebration by paying {5}{G}{G}, Proliferating Magistrate's Scepter and Tamiyo four times.
Activate Tamiyo's second ability by removing three loyalty counters to return Planewide Celebration from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter by tapping it and removing three charge counters, taking an extra turn after this one.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.
